summary.text: Kacey Blundell is the Democratic candidate for Indiana State Senate District 38 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She names public education, healthcare and utility oversight as her key priorities.

paragraphs.text: Kacey Blundell graduated from Terre Haute North Vigo High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Indiana State University.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a wife, mother, civil servant and rescue dog owner who is not beholden to the President, Governor or lobbyists.

She said she supports public schools, believes the current voucher system has undermined their stability, wants accessible and affordable healthcare, and wants stronger oversight of the Indiana Utility Regulatory Commission.
